The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the fourteenth season of {{aniseries|PTS}}, ''[[S14|Pokémon: Black & White]]'', in {{pmin|the United States}} and {{pmin|Canada}} ({{wp|DVD region code|DVD Region 1}}). ==Partial collections== Four ''Pokémon Black & White'' DVD sets were released between 2012-2013 by [[VIZ Media]] and distributed through {{wp|Warner Home Video}}, containing the whole season between them. Each set contains two discs. ===Set 1=== [[File:Pokémon Black and White DVD 1.png|thumb|200px|Pokémon: Black & White - Set 1]] Pokémon Black & White - Set 1 was released on November 20, 2012. It contains two discs with 12 episodes across them combined. {| class="roundy" style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{colorschemelight|Unova}}; border: 2px solid #{{colorschemedark|Unova}}" ! ''[[BW048|Battle for the Underground!]]'' |} ==The Complete Season== [[File:Pokémon the Series Black and White The Complete Season DVD.png|thumb|200px|right|Pokémon: Black and White - The Complete Season]] Pokémon: Black and White - The Complete Season, referred to as Pokémon The Series Black and White: Complete Season on VIZ Media's website, is a [[Complete Collection]] DVD set that was released on July 27, 2021 by [[VIZ Media]] and distributed through {{wp|Warner Home Video}}. This Complete Collection contains eight discs with 48 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is 3000086028. It consists of a single DVD case in a slip cover. Unusually when compared to other Complete Collection sets, the DVDs in this one are direct reissues of the 2012/2013 releases. {| class="roundtable" style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{colorschemelight|Unova}}; border: 3px solid #{{colorschemedark|Unova}};" !
